n: SikaRoof VersiJack CK Base Slope Corrector

d.t: SLOPE CORRECTOR FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack CK Base Slope Corrector is an accessory used to accommodate slope corrections arising from falls created on concrete surfaces for drainage purposes. Slope correctors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and can correct for slopes from 1% to 5%. SikaRoof VersiJack CK Base Slope Corrector is used in conjunction with either SikaRoof VersiJack or SikaRoof VersiJack K and is installed at the base of pedestals. This allows for more stability especially at higher heights as the pedestal is standing upright.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Slope corrector for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
